title: docs(pm-dispatch): fleet v2 text slice — focus epics, L2 sampling, liveness to triage, retired lane text
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Y1WwWpY7Vyz66HeEjnJVMF)_

Part of #34632

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：按 #34632 的裁决改 pm-dispatch 规则文本：重点 = 四主题 + 已确认的未暂停专题（席位自开的专题要你在父单确认才算）；L2 席每天抽查约五分之一的席位自审记录，最多 10 条、契约面先；座位活性巡查从总监移给分诊：分诊只发现和敲门，12 小时无答复后的释放和座位贴降级都由在线兄弟席做，没有兄弟席时分诊记进座位贴轮次记录，由总监降级和释放（这一分工是区的读法，你的 D7-A 原话只说「巡查从总监移给分诊」；照此读法，活性清理要靠有兄弟席在线，或有人召唤总监，请批准时一并确认）；删掉退役域车道的席位章程文字。总行数净减 4。
- **为什么改**：你 08:28Z 回了「全部 A，D4 加每日上限」；总监空着，活性巡查和 L2 抽查都停了，规则文本还写着旧分工。
- **风险与回滚**：只改内部规则文本与一个棘轮上限表，不碰产品代码；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`references/filing-gate.md` 第 8 条（定级）、`references/lanes/triage.md` 重点行、`references/lanes/l2-review.md` 抽查行。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs`，预期两行 ✓、exit 0。
- **需要你做的**：受管面（`.claude/**`），等 os-zhuang 批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

Every change executes #34632's ruling, comment 6943105103, except one reading marked below (D7: who makes the two liveness writes) (verbatim: 「全部 A，D4 加每日上限」 — 「九条都按卡上推荐，D3 用更正后的每天一次；L2 抽查每天最多 10 条、优先抽碰契约面的。D9 的召唤要你亲自做。」). This is the skills-text slice other than the verification seat's (`project-forms.md` seat words, `lanes/qa.md`, `lanes/eval.md`), which is a separate PR.

| Item | File and change |
|---|---|
| R3 + D1 (focus) | `lanes/triage.md`: the focus line now names the four themes plus every un-paused epic; a seat-opened epic counts only once the maintainer confirms it on the parent, and triage records new ones in its round record. |
| R3 (grading) | `filing-gate.md` item 8: the MCP-only uplift is replaced by the ruled theme rule: inside a focus area, a named customer or user effect is p1 and no direct effect is p2; outside, one grade below the impact row; maintainer-set grades stand; a p0 (main red, queue stall, security emergency) is not moved by it; it applies at first touch and retriage only, never as a sweep over the open backlog (6919310662 bullets 5 and 6). Item 1's order line runs item 7 before item 8. |
| D4 | `lanes/l2-review.md`: the L2 seat samples about 1 in 5 seat self-review records (≤50-line self-lands, self L2) a day, at most 10, contract faces first; a failed sample goes back to the seat. `lanes/director.md` 职责一 renamed to the governed-landing audit; L2 record quality sampling points to the L2 seat. |
| D7 | `seat-lifecycle.md` 33–34, `triage-duties.md` 87–88, `dispatch-runbook.md` 36–40: the liveness patrol moves to triage as finding: the re-check, the knock and the round-record line. Its two writes keep their shape and get a named actor, the online sibling seat (`lanes/triage.md:19` 「掉线或下班席的项归在线兄弟席…⛔ 分诊永不释放」): the post downgrade (`⏳ vacant` title + post assignee + evidence comment, one stroke, per `seat-lifecycle.md:25`) and, after `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS = 12` with no answer, the one relay release `label-write.mjs --release`. With no online sibling seat, both go to the director (`seat-lifecycle.md:33-34`, `dispatch-runbook.md:40`: the director downgrades and releases), listed by triage in its seat-post round record (`lanes/triage.md:7`: no chat round report). `lanes/triage.md:4`'s write list is unchanged. **This split is the area's reading, not a clause of the ruling.** D7-A says only "move the seat liveness patrol from director to triage". On `main` the director made the downgrade and the release. Here triage only finds and knocks, and both writes move to sibling seats, so D7-A's effect depends on a sibling being online. The other reading gives triage the two writes, which `lanes/triage.md:19` 「⛔ 分诊永不释放」 forbids today. The governed approval is also a word on this choice (L2 S5). `lanes/director.md:16` now adds 「接分诊交来的降级释放」 to the director's entry line. That line does not state the no-sibling condition; it comes from `seat-lifecycle.md:33-34` and `triage-duties.md:88`. |
| R1 | `lanes/objectstack.md`: 「域车道席照常运作」 removed; the lease read no longer names domain-lane seats. |
| Epic-lead naming | `coordinator.md` title: the maintainer-machine epic lead (formerly the local `coordinator#1`) is a different seat and does not use this page. |
| Retired lane text | `lanes/ui.md` −3 (seat-form lines), `lanes/spec.md` −1 (first-touch restatement). `lanes/skills.md`: the QA self-start ban (contradicts D2) now points at `qa.md`. |
| Fixture | `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` self-test fixture `RELEASE_TEXT_UNSIGNED`: its verbatim provenance quote now reads `triage-duties.md:88` as changed here (「…无答复 ⇒ 兄弟席一笔中继释放」). String only. |
| Ratchet | `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: ceilings lowered to the landed counts: `lanes/ui.md` 23→20, `lanes/spec.md` 43→42 (`filing-gate.md` holds 82). No ceiling rises. |

### Governing rulings for the focus text

- Themes, #6015 comment 6919310662 (maintainer's choice, verbatim): 「中文客户能用起来」「应用安装升级可靠」「性能与安全」; grading answered there: in a focus theme with a named customer or user effect p1, without a direct effect p2, outside the themes one grade lower, a maintainer-set grade unchanged.
- MCP, #6015 comment 6919337517 (verbatim): 「应用内搭建我觉得没有mcp 重要」「云端的应用内搭建还非常不成熟」 — MCP grades like the other three themes.
- R3, #34632 body (verbatim): 「只要没有暂停的专题，应该都是重点，这样行不行」; D1-A by ruling 6943105103.

### Payers (each deleted line and where its rule survives)

| Deleted line | Surviving home |
|---|---|
| `lanes/triage.md` old 5 「应用仓业务理由由该项目召唤的总监席复核;第三方应用的总监是其自身维护者。」 | in triage's read set: `cross-repo-coordination.md:7` 「…业务理由归召唤的总监席」; for the director: `lanes/director.md:25` 「应用仓召唤本席复核卡的业务理由首触,三出口同分诊;没把握 ⇒ 报该应用的总监(人)裁。」 |
| `lanes/l2-review.md` old 12 「何时送审只住 contract-review.md 送审路由行;请谁、怎么请只住本节,⛔ 不按席号路由。」 | `contract-review.md:19` 「送审路由只住此处」 and :21 「(请谁照 `lanes/l2-review.md`)」; 「⛔ 不按席号路由」 kept at `lanes/l2-review.md:15` |
| `lanes/ui.md` old 7 「本席是本仓 `ui/` 树的执行座位:在 objectstack 认领、派发、L1 审核、落地。」 | `lanes/objectstack.md:15` (all claimable cards across every `domain:*`) and :8 (areas, L1 threads, landing) |
| `lanes/ui.md` old 8 「⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type、定级…误标 `pm:retriage`+异议,整树归本席除外。」 | `lanes/objectstack.md:10`; SKILL.md 「`domain:*`、队列与级别只由分诊落笔」 and the `pm:retriage` state row |
| `lanes/ui.md` old 10 「落点不明留分诊首触,⛔ 不猜、不代判。」 | SKILL.md 「域由分诊读代码判定…说不出修复碰哪个文件就还不可标」 |
| `lanes/spec.md` old 34 「findings 首触定级归分诊席,本席只供证据;例外见 `triage-duties.md` 车道席自分诊。」 | `lanes/objectstack.md:10` 「首触、定级与 `domain:*` 仍归分诊(`triage-duties.md`)」 |
| `filing-gate.md` old 59–60 (MCP-only 假绿 definition, 「响亮拒绝…不升」) | superseded by 6919337517: MCP grades like the other themes; the instrument line that leaned on it now reads 「假绿(仪器)」 |

## Tests

No test logic changed. Text only, two ceiling rows, and one fixture string in `label-write.mjs`'s self-test.

## Acceptance notes

- Kept, recorded here: `dispatch-runbook.md:43` 「总监席巡查列等候逾 24h 的 PR」 still names a director patrol, which `lanes/director.md` 「直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron」 says does not exist. It is not liveness, so D7 leaves it; no card (internal wording, no user effect).
- Kept, recorded here: `lanes/qa.md:8` 「总监席巡查的新 tag 族读数」 also names a director patrol; that file is the verification slice's, so it is left to that PR.
- Kept, recorded here: the epic lead keeps signing with the `coordinator` lane word. `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` stays as is and reads it; the rename is in prose only. No card.

## Verification

- Round 1, head `4c8ef157`: `dispatch-gates --commands` 41 derived, 41 run, all exit 0; `--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED (`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3, formula and lint not built, then 0 after the locked build).
- Round 2 answers contract review 6944724499 (M1–M3, S1–S3, N1, N4). Head `aebae2d5`: the derived set is unchanged; 41 run, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; CI green on this head (every completed run success or expected skip); gate record `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/34632-gates-ran-r2.txt`. `check-skill-line-ratchet`, `check-skill-id-lint` and `label-write.mjs --self-test` (its reclaim-clock pin reads `triage-duties.md`) pass. `overlap-check --pr=34744,34745`: clean.
- Round 3 answers L1-a2 delta 6945342712 (one line): `triage-duties.md:88` now names the sibling seat as the releaser, and with no sibling the row goes to the director through the seat post's round record (`lanes/triage.md:7`). Head `bfb7933f`: `check-skill-line-ratchet`, `check-skill-id-lint` and `label-write.mjs --self-test` exit 0; `overlap-check --pr=34744` clean. The rest of the derived set ran green at `aebae2d5` and this delta is one text line in a file those gates already read.
- Round 4 answers contract review 6945546722 S4 (two lines in place, count unchanged): `seat-lifecycle.md:33` gives the downgrade to the director when no sibling is online, and `:34` says the director makes the release. Head `b953a099`: `check-skill-line-ratchet` and `check-skill-id-lint` exit 0; `overlap-check --pr=34744,34745` clean. S5 is marked in this body under D7.
- Round 4, continued (area, after L1-a2): `dispatch-runbook.md:40` gets the same no-sibling branch. 「自有」 was dropped there because line 39 already says the criterion is the incumbent's own output. The line is 120 B. N8: the `label-write.mjs` fixture quote now matches the file. Touching `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` derives 30 more gates, so 71 are derived; all 71 ran, all exit 0, and `--ran` shows 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 because its build closure was missing, then exited 0 after the locked build. Gate record: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/34632-gates-ran-r4.txt`. Head `58578e39`. `overlap-check --pr=34744,34745` is clean.
- Round 5 answers contract review 6946083908 S6 (in place, no line added): `lanes/director.md:16` gains 「;接分诊交来的降级释放」 (120 B, file stays 82). N9: the 速读 says the effect depends on a sibling being online or the director being summoned. Head `44623080`: the derived set is unchanged (71); all 71 rerun, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; record `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/34632-gates-ran-r5.txt`. `overlap-check --pr=34744,34745` clean.
